data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure: fill From and To with suggestions, set trip type and dates, optionally use points, search, continue to results, then open Sort & Filter, pick a sort option and Apply. It covers all the key parameters, but it leaves out the points toggle's position and the exact option labels, and it never names the sort option values.
